title: World Painter: inspect tool left-click does nothing (falls through to paint)

sections.what: The inspect tool (shortcut I) is defined in TOOLS array but not handled in onCellClick in editor-canvas.ts. Left-click in inspect mode falls through to paintAt() which tries to paint on the cell. Right-click (contextmenu) correctly calls inspectCell().
sections.why: User expects inspect tool to show cell details on click, but it paints instead. This is a regression - the tool exists in UI but the click handler is missing.
sections.how: Add an inspect case in onCellClick (editor-canvas.ts) before the paintAt fallback. The case should call inspectCell(p, x, y) to set state.inspected and trigger softRender which shows the cell panel.
